project.description: 150 kW rooftop solar system on a warehouse in Windsor, Ontario

criteria.name: Ontario electrical contractor licence
criteria.guidance: Licence held by the bidder itself and stated in the proposal.

fields.name: licence_holder
fields.description: Who holds the Ontario electrical contractor licence for this work. 'subcontractor' if the bidder relies on another company's licence.

fields.name: licence_number
fields.description: The licence number exactly as written, or null if none is given.

criteria.name: WSIB clearance and $5M liability insurance
criteria.guidance: Both WSIB clearance and at least $5M liability insurance confirmed in the proposal.

fields.name: wsib_clearance
fields.description: True only if the proposal states the bidder has current WSIB clearance.

fields.name: liability_insurance_cad
fields.description: Liability insurance coverage in CAD (e.g. 5000000 for $5M), or null if not stated.

criteria.name: Relevant experience
criteria.guidance: Commercial installs of 100 kW or more completed in the last 5 years.

fields.name: qualifying_installs
fields.description: Number of completed commercial installations of 100 kW or more that the proposal states. Null if no count is given.

fields.name: earliest_year_claimed
fields.description: The earliest year the stated installs could date from (e.g. 'since 2020' gives 2020; 'past four years' gives reference year minus 4). Null if not stated.

warn_if.message: Some claimed installs may be older than 5 years; reviewer should confirm the count.

criteria.name: Price
criteria.guidance: Lower total cost within the budget ceiling.

fields.name: total_price_cad
fields.description: Total all-in price in CAD as a plain number, or null if not stated.

fields.name: completion_weeks
fields.description: Committed completion time in weeks from award, or null if no firm duration is given.

criteria.name: Warranty
criteria.guidance: Length of panel and workmanship warranties.

fields.name: panel_warranty_years
fields.description: Panel (manufacturer) warranty length in years, or null.

fields.name: workmanship_warranty_years
fields.description: Workmanship (installation) warranty length in years, or null.

criteria.name: Team and approach
criteria.guidance: Named project lead, crew, safety and monitoring plan.

fields.name: named_project_lead
fields.description: True if a specific project lead or manager is committed (named or identified as a dedicated role now), false if only 'to be assigned'.

fields.name: crew_described
fields.description: True if the installation crew is described (size or composition).

fields.name: safety_plan
fields.description: True if a site safety plan is included.

fields.name: monitoring_plan
fields.description: True if post-installation system performance monitoring is offered. Progress reporting during construction does not count.
